name: file-list-views
summary: Fork's file-list vocabulary: Tree, List, Combined List
body:
A view-options menu on the changes list switches between a
collapsible file tree (folder glyphs, chevrons, per-file status
badges), Fork's default name-plus-dimmed-directory list, and the
full-path combined list; the choice persists. The commit detail's
File Tree tab is now interactive: pick a file, see its diff beside
the tree. Sidebar labels no longer wrap.
